parsed.name: USB2FIR 远红外传感器接口模块
parsed.description: 该设备是用于连接远红外热传感器的 USB 接口模块，常见于 Melexis MLX 系列 FIR 传感器评估或数据采集场景。它支持通信测试、能力与状态查询、存储器读写、进入引导加载模式，以及批量读取与热帧初始化/更新等操作。
parsed.description_en: This device is a USB interface module for far-infrared thermal sensors, commonly used with Melexis MLX-series FIR sensors in evaluation or data acquisition setups. It supports communication tests, capability and status queries, memory read/write, bootloader entry, and bulk data readout plus thermal frame initialization and updates.

actions.description: 发送回显测试值以验证通信链路是否正常。
actions.description_en: Transmit an echo test value to verify that the communication link is working.

actions.description: 读取接口模块支持的功能能力位。
actions.description_en: Read the capability bitfield that indicates which functions the interface module supports.

actions.description: 读取最近一次事务的状态。
actions.description_en: Read the status of the most recent transaction.

actions.description: 使设备跳转到引导加载模式，用于固件维护或升级。
actions.description_en: Make the device jump to bootloader mode for firmware maintenance or updates.

actions.description: 从指定起始地址读取一段设备存储器数据。
actions.description_en: Read a block of device memory starting from a specified address.

actions.description: 向指定起始地址写入一段设备存储器数据。
actions.description_en: Write a block of data to device memory starting at a specified address.

actions.description: 执行一次批量数据读取。
actions.description_en: Perform a bulk data read operation.

actions.description: 启动 BF 模式，并可设置刷新率。
actions.description_en: Start BF mode, with an optional refresh rate setting.

actions.description: 初始化帧数据结构，并设置默认温度值。
actions.description_en: Initialize the frame data structure and set a default temperature value.

actions.description: 使用新数据更新当前帧。
actions.description_en: Update the current frame with new data.
